## Scoped rules: read the matching file before editing
- `ai/rules/ui-layer.md` (src/ui/**): Page objects, components and *.locators.ts files
- `ai/rules/tests.md` (tests/**): Writing and changing specs
- `ai/rules/backend-and-data.md` (src/clients/**, src/data/**, src/schemas/**, data/**): API/DB/Salesforce clients, schemas and test data
- `ai/rules/config.md` (config/**, src/config/**, playwright.config.ts): Environments, tenants, secrets, devices

## Playbooks (also available as `/` commands from `.gemini/commands/`)
- `ai/playbooks/add-page-object.md`: Add a page object (or component) with its locator file
- `ai/playbooks/write-ui-test.md`: Write a UI end-to-end test (API arrange, UI act, DB/SOQL assert)
- `ai/playbooks/write-api-test.md`: Write an API test with schema validation and database cross-check
- `ai/playbooks/fix-failing-test.md`: Diagnose and fix a failing, flaky or self-healed test by root cause
- `ai/playbooks/add-environment-or-tenant.md`: Add an environment or tenant (config, secrets, health check)
- `ai/playbooks/review-change.md`: Review a change against the project rules before merging
